first_step_test: One broad handmade globe curve with a short flat bottom gives the beginner the full glass envelope and a fixed place for the base below it.

source.notes: Six-panel handmade felt-tip contact sheet. First private sheet was rejected because black flakes became white cutouts in the finish; repaired sheet keeps all three flakes black.

final_elements.name: globe outline
final_elements.description: One near-round glass envelope with a short straight bottom edge.

final_elements.name: pedestal base
final_elements.description: One low trapezoid base attached below the globe bottom.

final_elements.name: tiny pine
final_elements.description: One centered three-tier pine and short trunk inside the globe.

final_elements.name: snow bank
final_elements.description: One shallow curved snow line behind the pine trunk.

final_elements.name: three snowflakes
final_elements.description: Exactly three small asterisk snowflakes around the pine.

final_elements.name: base stripe
final_elements.description: One thin stripe within the established pedestal.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: Three short broken strokes below the pedestal.

frames.visible_job: Draw one broad near-round glass envelope with a short flat bottom.
frames.instruction: With black felt tip, draw one broad near-round curve from the lower-left glass corner up and around to the lower-right corner. Join the two ends with a short straight bottom edge.

frames.visible_job: Attach one low pedestal below the globe.
frames.instruction: From the two ends of the globe's flat bottom, angle outward and down, then join the corners with a wider flat base. Keep the round glass outline in place.

frames.visible_job: Add one three-tier pine with a short trunk inside the globe.
frames.instruction: Inside the globe, stack three pointed branch tiers from a small top point to a wider lower tier. Bring a short trunk down toward the glass bottom without touching the pedestal.

frames.visible_job: Add a shallow snow bank and three small flakes around the pine.
frames.instruction: Curve one shallow snow bank behind the pine trunk. Around the upper branches, place exactly three small asterisk snowflakes, separated so each reads clearly.

frames.visible_job: Add one pedestal stripe and three broken ground strokes.
frames.instruction: Run one thin horizontal stripe inside the pedestal, parallel to its bottom edge. Place three short separated ground strokes just under the base.

final_step.visible_job: Fill only the established glass, pine, base and snow shapes with marker.
final_step.instruction: Fill the existing pine deep teal, the established pedestal coral, and a pale aqua wash behind the tree. Leave the snow bank white and keep all three black snowflakes clear; reinforce only the existing contours and three ground strokes.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains one thick imperfect round glass curve and a short flat bottom, centered with open interior and clear space for its base.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Six saved square crops keep one globe, pedestal, centered three-tier pine, one bank, exactly three black flakes, one base stripe and three ground strokes at stable anchors. The first sheet with white finish flakes was rejected; the repaired saved finish preserves black flakes. No temporary guides appear or disappear.

transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction adds only the attached pedestal below the established flat glass bottom.

transitions.observed_addition: Globe and pedestal stay at the same anchors; one centered three-tier pine and short trunk appear inside the glass.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction gives the three branch tiers and a short trunk within the existing globe.

transitions.observed_addition: The same pine and pedestal persist; a shallow bank rises behind the trunk and exactly three separated black asterisk flakes appear above and beside the tree.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction places one bank behind the trunk and exactly three distinct flakes around the upper tree.

transitions.observed_addition: The globe, tree, bank and three flakes remain; one stripe spans the existing base and three short broken black ground strokes appear below it.
transitions.instruction_match: The fifth instruction draws one base stripe and exactly three separated ground strokes.

transitions.observed_addition: The same tree, three black flakes, white bank, base stripe and three ground strokes persist; streaky teal, aqua and coral fill only established regions.
transitions.instruction_match: The finish instruction fills the pine, glass background and base with marker while keeping the black flakes and white bank visible.
